description: Declarative local-first observability pack for run ledgers, event evidence, privacy-safe cost/latency summaries, and incident review handoffs.

schema.description: JSON Schema files for observability events and ledger records.

checklist.description: Operational review checklist assets used before handoff or closure.

template.description: Reusable local-first document templates for incident summaries and postmortems.

optional_integrations.reason: Model-quality metrics and eval scoring are handed to the model evals pack; this pack records evidence and owner boundaries.
Security-sensitive findings are handed to security review after observability redaction evidence is assembled.
Release incidents and deployment gates are handed to devops/release once the run ledger and incident evidence are complete.
Agent-service runtime changes stay with the services pack; observability supplies summaries and postmortem templates.

overlap_notes.defaultspack: Owns active grants, pack selection, and runtime enforcement.
overlap_notes.rumi_model_evals_pack: Owns model scoring; observability owns run evidence and cost/latency summaries.
overlap_notes.rumi_security_review_pack: Owns vulnerability analysis; observability owns redacted incident records.
overlap_notes.rumi_devops_release_pack: Owns release gates and rollback execution; observability owns incident evidence packets.
